I even have one working in the back of my shop, helping me maintain some of my older models. Did you notice that little receiver dish on its dome? Pretty cute, eh? I should point out that there is one little thing about R8s that makes them, shall we say, less than perfect. Now, don't get me wrong, friend- these Droids are great!
